description: Find roofing, siding or gutter contractors in a US city, or near a US ZIP code, from The Roofing List. Give city and state, or zip. A zip returns the nearest firms within 25 miles, nearest first. Returns only listed businesses that are open and passed our contact check. Ratings come from reviews published on The Roofing List only.

city.description: US city name, for example "Austin". Give city and state, or zip.

state.description: US state as a USPS code ("TX") or a full name ("Texas"). Give city and state, or zip.

trade.description: The trade: roofing, siding or gutters.

zip.description: A 5-digit US ZIP code, for example "78701". Returns the nearest firms within 25 miles, nearest first. With zip, city and state are ignored.

name: search_contractors

rating.description: From reviews published on The Roofing List only. Absent when there are none.

value.description: Average of published reviews on The Roofing List, 1 to 5.

title: Search contractors
